svg.title: Ethan Soh
svg.desc: Ethan's TV wallpaper as a banner: oil paintings of a Formula 1 car at Spa-Francorchamps, a 911 above a city at night and a 911 by a lake crossfade slowly. The name ETHAN SOH stands where the TV draws its clock, behind each painting's subject, under the line: applied AI, agent engineering, AI security.
